content.title: Define batch status workflow
content.statement: Every batch of plants moves through one status ladder: propagating, growing, ready, sold. A batch can be marked discarded at any step.
content.context: Aisha showed two versions of the count screen. Both need a status for each batch of plants, and the prototype has no status field yet.
content.rationale: The group needed a consistent way to track plant batches through the greenhouse lifecycle.
alternatives: Keep the prototype without a status field
Add a status field but not define a workflow
content.impacts: Adds status field to count screen prototype and batch table, defines workflow for all batches

sources.excerpt: Decision: every batch of plants moves through one status ladder: propagating, growing, ready, sold. A batch can be marked discarded at any step.
Aisha showed two versions of the count screen. Both need a status for each batch of plants, and the prototype has none yet.
Aisha: add the status ladder to the count screen prototype by 17 March.
Marc: add a status field to the batch table in the local database.
Decision: the board kept the one status ladder for every batch for version 1, and separate statuses per crop type were set aside.
Julie explained why the board chose a single ladder: growers move between benches all day, and one set of statuses means they learn the screen once.
Paul asked again for separate statuses for each crop type, because cuttings and bought-in plants do not start from seed.
